title: Assembly of JAZ-JAZ and JAZ-NINJA complexes in jasmonate signaling.
authors: Zhou, X Edward; Zhang, Yaguang; Yao, Jian; Zheng, Jie; Zhou, Yuxin; He, Qing; Moreno, Javier; Lam, Vinh Q; Cao, Xiaoman; Sugimoto, Koichi; Vanegas-Cano, Leidy; Kariapper, Leena; Suino-Powell, Kelly; Zhu, Yuanye; Novick, Scott; Griffin, Patrick R; Zhang, Feng; Howe, Gregg A; Melcher, Karsten
one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold建模与生化/生物物理分析，研究JAZ-JAZ和JAZ-NINJA复合物组装及动态界面，属于广义蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Jasmonates (JAs) are plant hormones with crucial roles in development and stress resilience. They activate MYC transcription factors by mediating the proteolysis of MYC inhibitors called JAZ proteins. In the absence of JA, JAZ proteins bind and inhibit MYC through the assembly of MYC-JAZ-Novel Interactor of JAZ (NINJA)-TPL repressor complexes. However, JAZ and NINJA are predicted to be largely intrinsically unstructured, which has precluded their experimental structure determination. Through a combination of biochemical, mutational, and biophysical analyses and AlphaFold-derived ColabFold modeling, we characterized JAZ-JAZ and JAZ-NINJA interactions and generated models with detailed, high-confidence domain interfaces. We demonstrate that JAZ, NINJA, and MYC interface domains are dynamic in isolation and become stabilized in a stepwise order upon complex assembly. By contrast, most JAZ and NINJA regions outside of the interfaces remain highly dynamic and cannot be modeled in a single conformation. Our data indicate that the small JAZ Zinc finger expressed in Inflorescence Meristem (ZIM) motif mediates JAZ-JAZ and JAZ-NINJA interactions through separate surfaces, and our data further suggest that NINJA modulates JAZ dimerization. This study advances our understanding of JA signaling by providing insights into the dynamics, interactions, and structure of the JAZ-NINJA core of the JA repressor complex.
abstract_zh: 茉莉酸（JAs）是植物激素，在发育和逆境适应中发挥关键作用。它们通过介导称为JAZ蛋白的MYC抑制因子的蛋白水解来激活MYC转录因子。在缺乏JA的情况下，JAZ蛋白通过组装MYC-JAZ-NINJA（JAZ的新型互作因子）-TPL抑制复合物来结合并抑制MYC。然而，JAZ和NINJA被预测为大部分内在无序，这阻碍了其实验结构测定。通过结合生化、突变和生物物理分析以及AlphaFold衍生的ColabFold建模，我们表征了JAZ-JAZ和JAZ-NINJA相互作用，并生成了具有详细、高置信度结构域界面的模型。我们证明，JAZ、NINJA和MYC界面结构域在分离状态下是动态的，并在复合物组装过程中逐步稳定。相比之下，JAZ和NINJA在界面之外的大多数区域仍高度动态，无法以单一构象建模。我们的数据表明，小的JAZ锌指表达在花序分生组织（ZIM）基序通过分离的表面介导JAZ-JAZ和JAZ-NINJA相互作用，且我们的数据进一步提示NINJA调节JAZ二聚化。本研究通过提供对JA抑制复合物JAZ-NINJA核心的动态、相互作用和结构的见解，增进了我们对JA信号传导的理解。
